resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Vietnamese source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review checks, typecheck, complete build, route and generated-link checks, and the full test suite passed after the cycle was finalized.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Vietnamese pass identified eleven remaining trigonometry, circuit, and imperial-unit terminology defects; all eleven were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Vietnamese human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted for this cycle.

findings.summary: The Vietnamese right-triangle formulas retained English side labels.
evidence: The formulas used opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse instead of Vietnamese side terminology.
findings.resolution: Localized all three side labels as cạnh đối, cạnh kề, and cạnh huyền.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas retained English side labels.
evidence: The previous expressions contained opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse.
findings.resolution: Localized the side labels while preserving inverse-function notation.

findings.summary: The series-cell formula retained the English word series in a Vietnamese annotation.
The parallel-branch voltage formula retained an English annotation.
evidence: The previous expression ended with (parallel branches).
findings.resolution: Changed it to (các nhánh song song).

findings.summary: The length-conversion heading used a literal Vietnamese phrase for metric length.
evidence: The previous heading was Inch và chiều dài số liệu, where số liệu does not mean metric.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Inch và chiều dài hệ mét.

findings.summary: The foot conversion used an English plural-form fragment inconsistent with the localized formula style.
evidence: The previous formula mixed foot, inch, and Vietnamese text.
findings.resolution: Normalized the formula to the technical Vietnamese unit forms used in the section.

findings.summary: The yard conversion retained the English plural feet fragment.
evidence: The previous formula was 1 yard = 3 feet = 0,9144 m.
findings.resolution: Changed feet to the Vietnamese technical foot form.

findings.summary: The right-triangle section mixed Vietnamese prose with English formula terminology.
evidence: The paragraph defined Vietnamese side terms while the displayed formulas retained English labels.
findings.resolution: Aligned all displayed ratios with the Vietnamese explanation.

findings.summary: The angle-finding section was inconsistent across inverse formulas and the surrounding Vietnamese prose.
evidence: The inverse formulas did not reuse the Vietnamese side terminology from the preceding explanation.
findings.resolution: Applied one consistent Vietnamese terminology set throughout the section.

findings.summary: The imperial-length subsection mixed Vietnamese text with English unit fragments.
evidence: The formulas and heading followed inconsistent localization conventions.
findings.resolution: Normalized the heading and remaining foot-unit forms.

findings.summary: The parallel-branch annotation was the remaining English label in the circuit formulas.
evidence: The surrounding Vietnamese voltage-law section used Vietnamese terminology while this annotation remained English.
findings.resolution: Changed the annotation to các nhánh song song.
